# al-Kindi

> A digital product studio working from interfaces to smart contracts.

al-Kindi is a small, focused studio that designs brands, ships products, and engineers onchain systems. The studio is named after Abu Yusuf Yaʻqub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi, the 9th-century Baghdadi polymath who invented cryptanalysis.

The studio works between Lisbon and Istanbul. Legal entity: Alkindi, Unipessoal LDA.

## Services

- [Brand & Visual Identity](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Brand systems made to be used, not just admired. Naming, marks, type, color, voice, designed as one and built to last.
- [Copywriting](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Plain words for complex products. Brand voice, landing pages, UI microcopy, long-form, written to land on first read.
- [Web Design](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Strategy, design, build, and ship; one studio handles every layer, from sitemap to semantic markup to deployment.
- [Graphics & Digital Art](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Original illustration, motion, and motifs. By hand or by code, never from a stock library.
- [User Experience Design](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Research, synthesis, structure, validation. The right problem framed before it is solved.
- [User Interface Design](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Interfaces that do not need a guide, a tutorial, or a tooltip. Components, tokens, states, prototypes, drawn and shipped intact.
- [Web App Development](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Web apps shipped with everything a new team needs to take over: code, docs, tests, deploy pipeline. Smallest codebase that does the job.
- [Technical Advisory](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): Architecture reviews, tech decisions, Web3 integration, security posture. Written assessments with a recommendation, including 'don't' when that is the answer.
- [Smart Contract Development](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): EVM contracts shipped audit-ready. Invariants written before the contracts, every state path covered before deploy.
- [Smart Contract Audits](https://www.alkindi.pt/#services): EVM contract audits that end in remediation, not just findings. Each finding root-caused, each fix reviewed.
